pm_enabled_flag.meaning: PM is enabled so executeHedge() calls notifyVaultSupply(spotToken, params.perpAsset)

hedge_order_submitted_flag.meaning: a hedge order is submitted while the L1 fill or PM auto-supply does not happen

supplied_slot_absent.meaning: the corresponding 0x811 supplied slot does not exist

accounting_available.meaning: totalBacking(), distributableSurplus() and settleDailyPnL() complete without reverting (accounting not bricked)

claims.scope: PM hedge registration adds a vaultSupplied entry before the HyperCore 0x811 supplied slot exists, causing strict suppliedBalance reads to revert and brick accounting/settlement

preconditions.text: PM is enabled so executeHedge() calls notifyVaultSupply(spotToken, params.perpAsset).; A hedge order is submitted but the L1 fill or PM auto-supply does not happen.; The corresponding 0x811 supplied slot does not exist.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: A submitted hedge order must not be enough to make protocol accounting and settlement unavailable; accounting should reflect confirmed retrievable backing rather than assume an external PM supplied slot exists.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: totalBacking(), distributableSurplus() and settleDailyPnL() are bricked by the revert.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: PM is enabled and executeHedge() invokes notifyVaultSupply for the submitted hedge order.
The hedge order submission is the only trigger; no L1 fill or PM auto-supply creates the 0x811 supplied slot.
The strict suppliedBalance read is the sole cause of the accounting revert in this scenario.

limitations: Formalizes only the accounting_bricked impact; vault.settle() bricking (settle_bricked) is a separate impact not covered by this plan.
The relation is a Boolean completion obligation because the report gives no numeric definition of accounting availability.
